rationale.correct: Step 1: Cooling output = 3 TR × 12,000 BTU/hr = 36,000 BTU/hr = 10.55 kW. Step 2: Current split-type annual energy = 10.55 kW ÷ 3.2 COP × 6 hr × 365 = 7.2 MWh/year × ₱14,000/MWh = ₱100,800/year. Step 3: VRF annual energy = 10.55 kW ÷ 3.8 COP × 6 × 365 = 5.7 MWh/year × ₱14,000 = ₱80,200/year. Step 4: Annual savings = ₱100,800 − ₱80,200 = ₱20,600/year. Step 5: Simple payback = ₱150,000 capital ÷ ₱20,600 annual savings = 7.3 years ≈ 7.5 years. This is typical for residential VRF upgrade scenarios. Source: LEA-UTIL-002-04 Module energy cost examples.
rationale.takeaway: VRF payback calculation: Energy savings = (Cooling output ÷ Old COP − Cooling output ÷ New COP) × Annual operating hours × Electricity rate; payback ~7–8 years typical for residential units, justifying upgrade in medium-to-long-term ownership scenarios.
